title: Inferno Escape Room
specs: Private escape rooms only, no strangers
Rooms are spacious and not scary or claustrophobic
LIT and Date Night Disaster not ideal for kids under 11
Candy Shoppe and Santa’s Workshop playable by kids 5 and older
One adult per 2 children under 10 recommended
Teens 13-17 must have paying adult present who is financially responsible
Children under 5 not allowed unless safely secured in harness, carrier, or stroller
No intoxication allowed; must be mentally capable to play
Rooms hold 3-8 players, Date Night Disaster 2-4 players max
Can accommodate up to 30 people for facility rental
gap: Price per room or per person not stated
blurb: Guests solve puzzles and complete a specific objective in themed escape rooms within 60 minutes. Rooms are private and designed for various group sizes and ages. The experience includes a game master and is suitable for families, parties, and corporate events.
extraNote: Nonrefundable advance payment required to reserve private room · Booking can be rescheduled more than 24 hours in advance · If time slot is resold after cancellation, fee will be waived · No refunds if showing up intoxicated or under influence · Private booking only; no playing with strangers · University Shop, south corner of Price and University, Tempe, AZ
